title: Fermentation: Curd, Idli and Bread
summary: How yeast and Lactobacillus turn dough into bread, milk into curd and rice-and-dal into idli batter.

ib.note: Anaerobic respiration equations follow in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye
Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Microorganisms: Friend and Foe

objectives: I can explain how yeast makes dough rise and how Lactobacillus makes curd.
I can describe the conditions microbes need for fermentation.
I can plan a fair test on fermentation.
misconceptions: Yeast is a chemical, not a living thing.
Hotter is always better for fermentation.
Curd sets because of the heat of the milk alone.
